publisher: Nebraska Secretary of State through Nebraska.gov
reassessment_reason: Differentiate the documented special-request CSV from the recurring fixed-width FTP batch. The migration FAQ now expressly describes a future account-required bulk route without a Nebraska.gov subscription; it does not prove that route is live or free.

access.bulk: Subscriber service describes full fixed-width multi-file FTP deliveries. Separate special-request CSV supplies selected matches.
access.api: No public supported business-entity API contract was established.
access.search: Special-request form supports entity type, registration date, keyword, city or ZIP filters; no query was submitted.
access.fees: Legacy contract: $800 per monthly delivery, $500 per delivery twice monthly, or $300 per weekly delivery; six-month minimum. Subscriber account $100/year. Special-request CSV $15/1,000 records. Replacement bulk price unverified.

fields.summary: Batch schema remains unpublished. The special-request CSV page lists entity name, principal/designated office address and Nature of Business where available; it explicitly excludes officers/directors and registered agents. The subscriber summary instead mentions officer name, an unresolved documentation conflict. Neither establishes a batch schema or stable identifier.

active_status_semantics: No complete current status codebook or production status mapping was established. Special-request criteria are not evidence of operational activity.
statewide_completeness: Full set refers to the SOS registry. Neither product proves all operating businesses, physical sites or a current count.
address_zip: CSV office locations may be in or outside Nebraska; entity-office and registered-agent searches are separate. ZIP coverage and address roles for the batch remain unresolved; future normalization must retain ZIP5/ZIP4 separately.
automation_terms_fees: Legacy agreement specifies FTP retrieval and six-month commitment. General site terms restrict automated copying without prior written permission. Replacement FAQ says the Nebraska.gov subscription will no longer be needed for bulk when live, but a new account is required; no account was created.
redistribution: General site terms restrict commercial reuse, redistribution and derivatives. Their application alongside a product-specific batch agreement and replacement system needs resolution; no redistribution grant is asserted.
temporal_refresh: Weekly/twice-monthly/monthly batch schedules are documented. Replacement is anticipated before end of 2026; exact cutover, layouts, identifier crosswalk, overlap and correction/deletion handling remain unverified.

citations.evidence: Legacy full fixed-width FTP service and conflicting special-request summary.
Per-delivery fees, six-month minimum and FTP-only legacy agreement.
Annual subscriber fee published; form not submitted.
Read-only landing-page criteria, CSV fields and explicit excluded people/agent fields.
Future bulk route removes legacy subscription requirement but requires account; exact launch unconfirmed.

strongest_next_action: Prioritize the replacement system's published bulk contract and migration notices before considering a six-month legacy commitment. Resolve CSV field conflicts and batch schema independently; require identifier crosswalk, status/address definitions, counts, transfer terms and derived-use scope. No account, order, query, source contact, automation or production change is authorized.
